name: Baseus GaN5 Pro 65W Fast Charger (2x Type-C + 1x USB-A)

short: Upgraded 5th Gen GaN Tech, 65W Power Delivery for MacBook & Windows Laptops, 3 Ports Simultaneous
shortBn: আপগ্রেডেড ৫ম প্রজন্মের জিএএন টেকনোলজি, ম্যাকবুক ও ল্যাপটপের জন্য ৬৫ ওয়াট পিডি, একসাথে ৩টি ডিভাইস
description: 5th generation Gallium Nitride (GaN) technology makes this adapter 55% smaller than traditional laptop power bricks. Smart BPS II power distribution intelligently splits current between laptop, phone, and tablet without disconnecting or surging.

specs.Fast Charge Protocols: PD 3.0, QC 4.0+, PPS 45W (Samsung Super Fast), AFC, FCP
specs.Cable Included: Complimentary Baseus 100W Type-C to Type-C 1m cable

highlights: Powers MacBook Pro/Air and Dell XPS at full 65W speed
Charges iPhone 15/16 from 0 to 50% in 25 minutes
Includes genuine 100W E-marker charging cable in box
55% smaller compact footprint fits easily in pockets

name: Ugreen Nexode 100W 4-Port GaN Fast Charger
short: 100W Single Port Max Output, 3x Type-C + 1x USB-A, Charges 2 Laptops Simultaneously
shortBn: একক পোর্টে ১০০ ওয়াট ম্যাক্স আউটপুট, ৩টি টাইপ-সি ও ১টি ইউএসবি-এ পোর্ট, একসাথে ২টি ল্যাপটপ চার্জিং
description: The desktop powerhouse from Ugreen. Supports up to 100W Power Delivery to fast charge a MacBook Pro 16-inch to 50% in only 30 minutes. Four ports allow power users to clean their desks and replace 4 separate power bricks with one unit.

specs.Protection: Thermal Guard dynamic heat monitoring checks temp 800 times/sec

highlights: Charges MacBook Pro 16" at full 100W speed
